fusions.name: Scattershot Cloud
fusions.desc: Fires 6 locusts in a wide spray, each one dealing 11 damage and knocking its target back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: The Last Report
fusions.desc: Fires a single locust fast into the first enemy it meets, dealing 18 damage, consuming every affliction you have on it and dealing 60% more for each one.

fusions.name: Rattling Volleys
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 12 seconds. For 10 seconds, an escort of locusts fights beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Next Round Chambered
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your next strike has 20% more critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds.
